cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

mechanism: A assumes control of the post-contest discussion and directs B from an embarrassing result toward effort, learning or next actions on A terms.
confusable: D196 demands a deserved win; D206 evades the embarrassing result itself and keeps discussing other evaluative dimensions.
comparison: Quiz captain defers score questions through learning and effort; stopped runner converts noncompletion into a strategy review.
seedUse: Read both exact cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve result-related B prompts and the specific subject A chooses instead, without claiming unspoken scores or reasons as fact.
